title: Garden Veggies for Kids! Tomato, Lettuce and More with Kiko
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is my buddy Kiko the broccoli!
Welcome to Fruity Friends! Today we're visiting the garden to meet five green and growing friends.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Yummy food and healthy habits help us grow, play and learn every day.
Ready? Let's go to the kitchen and find out!

lines: Here's a clue: it's round and red, and it grows on a leafy green plant! Can you guess?
This is Tomato! Can you say tomato?
Tomatoes grow on plants in the garden. They start out small and green.
In the warm sun, they turn red. Some tomatoes turn yellow, orange or even purple!
Can you grow tall like a tomato plant? Stretch your arms like leafy branches!
Is a tomato a fruit or a veggie?
It's a fruit, because it has seeds inside! But we often eat it like a veggie.
One more time, nice and loud: TOMATO!
Tomatoes are juicy in salads, and they make yummy sauce, too.
Here's a clue: it's long and green, cool and crunchy! Can you guess?
This is Cucumber! Can you say cucumber?
Cucumbers grow on vines that love to climb up and up.
Cucumbers are mostly water inside. That's why they feel so cool and fresh!
Can you climb like a cucumber vine? Hand over hand, up, up, up!
What can a cucumber turn into?
A pickle! Pickles are cucumbers soaked in a special salty juice.
One more time, nice and loud: CUCUMBER!
Cucumber slices are cool and crunchy on a warm day.
Here's a clue: it's green and leafy, and it's crunchy in a salad! Can you guess?
This is Lettuce! Can you say lettuce?
Lettuce grows in the garden, close to the ground.
Lots of leaves grow together in a round bunch called a head.
Can you crunch like lettuce? Make a big crunchy sound! Crunch, crunch!
What can we make with lettuce?
A salad! Or put it in a sandwich for a crunchy bite.
One more time, nice and loud: LETTUCE!
Lettuce can be green or even red, with leaves that are curly or flat.
Here's a clue: it's shiny and crunchy, and it comes in lots of colors! Can you guess?
This is Bell Pepper! Can you say bell pepper?
Bell peppers can be green, yellow, orange or red.
Many peppers start out green. If they stay on the plant longer, they change color!
Can you name a pepper color with me? Red! Yellow! Orange! Green!
It's almost empty, with lots of tiny seeds in the middle!
Let's say it together: BELL PEPPER!
One more time, nice and loud: BELL PEPPER!
Bell peppers are crunchy and a little bit sweet. Not spicy at all!
Here's a clue: it's when we pick food from the garden, because it's ready to eat! Can you guess?
This is a garden harvest! Can you say harvest?
Plants need sunshine, water and good soil to grow.
When the food is ready, we pick it. That's called a harvest!
Can you pretend to dig, plant and water a seed? Dig, drop, sprinkle!
What do plants need to grow?
Sunshine, water and soil! And a little bit of time.
One more time, nice and loud: HARVEST!
After gardening, we wash our hands and the food we picked.

recap: Yummy! Let's remember what we learned.
Bell pepper, in lots of colors.
outro: Which one was your favorite? Tell a grown-up, and try something new this week!
Bye, friends! See you next time on Fruity Friends!
